- **Coverage Status:** Defined as `partial` with method `predictor_bounded_strongholds_v2` in [`src/seed_search/catalog/extract.py`](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/b9c67897078b/workspace/src/seed_search/catalog/extract.py#L132-L134).

- **Path:** [`fixtures/bedrock-26.52/regression-expectations-v1.json`](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/b9c67897078b/workspace/fixtures/bedrock-26.52/regression-expectations-v1.json#L16-L34)
